## Description
Provide a concise explanation of what this pull request does, what bug it fixes, or what feature it adds.

## Related Issue
Closes # (issue number)

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🎨 Code style / formatting / refactor
- [ ] 🧪 Tests (added or updated)

- [ ] Android
- [ ] Windows

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project (`flutter analyze` passes with 0 issues).
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code where necessary, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works (`flutter test` passes).
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets, private API keys, or personal credentials are included in this PR.
